$comment: Report categories (bipe-chat/bipe#697, ADR 0170; design: Moderation in layers and trusted flaggers, sections 2, 5 and 6). A report carries one id. firstActionMinutes is the operator charter target from the report's arrival to the operator's first action (hide, suspend, or a decision to keep). flaggerEligible: an accredited trusted flagger may file this category. No political or disinformation category (ADR 0174). Strings: bipe_report_category_<id> (the name) and bipe_report_category_<id>_hint (one line under it). The sealed report format is docs/report-envelope.md. The order is the order of the report sheet. Values are defaults until the charter (#629) fixes them.
